links.outcome: AI/CAD false negative rate versus expert reference standard on LDCT nodules
links.effect: Combined cohort false negative rates were 12.7% for Vendor A and 14.7% for Vendor B; missed nodules were mostly GGOs (92.3% and 78.6% in the primary cohort).
links.quote: The AI systems demonstrated significant and comparable false negative rates in the combined cohort: 12.7% for Vendor A and 14.7% for Vendor B.

links.outcome: Nodules missed by AI/CAD that experts confirmed
links.effect: AI missed expert-confirmed nodules (12.7% Vendor A, 14.7% Vendor B), mostly faint GGOs with mean attenuation around -730 HU, showing cases AI overlooks would be missed without clinician review.
links.quote: The vast majority of missed nodules were GGOs (92.3% and 78.6%, respectively, in the primary cohort).

unlisted_practices: Characterize AI failure conditions such as a nodule density threshold (-730 HU) and anatomical location, and target manual verification at those cases

screen.reason: This is an empirical diagnostic accuracy and failure analysis study evaluating two commercial CAD systems on retrospective CT datasets to identify algorithmic blind spots (faint ground-glass opacities), but it does not compare outcomes of implementing a specific deployment practice.
